e.title: CatRiskSim：明说自己不是 RMS 或 AIR 的教育性巨灾模拟器，并给测试定下四条不变量
e.title_en: CatRiskSim: an educational catastrophe simulator that states outright it is not a substitute for RMS or AIR, and gives its tests four invariants
e.title_hk: CatRiskSim：明說自己不是 RMS 或 AIR 的教育性巨災模擬器，並給測試定下四條不變量
e.summary: 一个组合级巨灾风险模拟项目：泊松事件频率、对数正态事件严重度、蒙特卡洛年度总损失，算出期望年损失、VaR 与 TVaR，并单列模型不确定性情景、SQL 组合查询与地理暴露可视化；它开篇即声明自己是教育性模拟器而非 RMS／AIR 之类商业巨灾模型的替代，且明说不主张具备专有模型或生产保险数据的经验
e.summary_hk: 一個組合級巨災風險模擬項目：泊松事件頻率、對數正態事件嚴重度、蒙特卡洛年度總損失，算出期望年損失、VaR 與 TVaR，並單列模型不確定性情景、SQL 組合查詢與地理暴露可視化；它開篇即聲明自己是教育性模擬器而非 RMS／AIR 之類商業巨災模型的替代，且明說不主張具備專有模型或生產保險資料的經驗
e.summary_en: A portfolio-level catastrophe risk simulation project: Poisson event frequency, lognormal event severity and Monte Carlo annual aggregate loss, producing expected annual loss, VaR and TVaR, with separate treatment of model-uncertainty scenarios, SQL portfolio queries and geospatial exposure visualisation; it states at the outset that it is an educational simulator rather than a substitute for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR, and explicitly does not claim experience with proprietary models or production insurance data
e.body:
**CatRiskSim** 是一个**组合级巨灾风险与组合损失模拟项目**（仓库 `anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 2,069 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,896 字节**，**另有实测 `RESULTS.md`（1,360 字节）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第一种：把「我不主张什么」写成开篇第一段**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**仓库描述逐字**：**「Stochastic catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulator using Monte Carlo, SQL, and geospatial analysis.」**；**根目录实测含 `.gitignore`、`README.md`、**`RESULTS.md`**、`data/`、`outputs/`、`requirements.txt`、`sql/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇的「Important scope（重要范围说明）」逐字，是本条目最有价值的一段**：**「This is an **educational simulator**, **not a replacement for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR**. The hazard and vulnerability relationships are **synthetic and deliberately simplified**.」**——**即「这是一个**教育性模拟器**，**不是 RMS 或 AIR 之类商业巨灾模型的替代品**。其灾害与脆弱性关系是**合成的、且刻意简化过的**」**。**其建模框架逐字实测（公式原样）**：**事件频率 `N ~ Poisson(lambda)`**；**事件严重度 `S ~ Lognormal(mu, sigma)`**；**单事件损失 `Loss = Exposure × Vulnerability × HazardFactor × ProximityFactor`，并受保额上限约束**；**年度总损失 `AggregateLoss_t = sum(Loss_i) for all events i in year t`**；**再由模拟出的年度损失分布计算 EAL、95%／99% VaR 与 95%／99% TVaR**。**代码结构逐字实测**：`src/generate_data.py`（生成合成暴露组合与随机事件目录）、`src/simulate_losses.py`（模拟年度巨灾损失）、`src/run_sql.py`（把组合载入 SQLite 并跑分析查询）、`src/visualize.py`（损失分布与地理风险图）、`sql/analysis.sql`、`tests/test_simulation.py`、`outputs/`。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「明说自己不是 RMS／AIR 的替代」是本条目最有价值的一点，也是本会话见到对**边界**最直白的开篇声明之一**——**商业巨灾模型（RMS、AIR、CoreLogic／RQE 等）是该行业的实务工具**，**而教育性模拟器与它们之间最容易发生的误读就是**把教学的简化当成可用的近似****；**作者把这条误读写成了开篇第二句**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其简化程度恰当或可用于任何真实定价**——**本次未运行其模型**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「它不主张什么」被写成了与主张并列的一段**——**逐字**：**「It intentionally covers several items in the **Marsh Re internship description** that are absent from a typical AI/ML student resume: stochastic modelling, risk/loss distributions, model uncertainty, SQL, geospatial analysis, interpretation of modelled loss outputs, quality-control checks, process automation. **It does not claim experience with proprietary RMS/AIR/RQE models or production insurance data.**」**——**即它明确说自己是**对着一份具名的实习描述（Marsh Re）**来补齐典型 AI/ML 学生简历上没有的项**，**并**明确声明不主张**拥有专有模型或生产保险数据的经验**。⭐⭐ **对正在求职的学生，这是一份罕见的、**把「我的项目补哪一块」与「我不声称补到了哪一块」同时写清**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该实习描述在别处可见或该对齐有效**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它给测试定下四条不变量，是本条目在工程上最值得记的一点**——**`RESULTS.md` 逐字列出测试套件验证的内容**：**「losses cannot be negative; **expected loss is below tail-risk quantiles**; **TVaR is at least as large as the corresponding VaR**; **all intended uncertainty scenarios are present**」**——**即①损失不能为负；②期望损失必须低于尾部风险分位数；③**TVaR 必须不小于对应的 VaR**；④所有预期的不确定性情景都必须存在****。⭐⭐ **前三条是**分布内部一致性**（单调性／支撑集）的检查，第四条是**完整性**检查**；**对做随机模型的学生，这是一组**不依赖具体数值就能发现结构性错误**的断言**（**可与 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本次未运行其 pytest，未核实这四条确实通过**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 把一次具体运行的全部关键数值与假设并列，是本条目最便于核对的一处**——**逐字实测**：**年度试验 **20,000** 次；暴露记录 **1,500** 条；核心频率模型 **Poisson(lambda=2.2)**；严重度模型 Lognormal**；**并逐字声明「Results are synthetic and for educational use.」**；**其风险指标表逐字为**：**期望年损失（EAL）$261.51M｜95% VaR $710.80M｜95% TVaR $855.18M｜99% VaR $975.95M｜99% TVaR $1,087.37M｜P(Loss > $50M) 74.62%｜P(Loss > $100M) 67.91%**。⭐⭐ **这些数值得以被核对的前提是**假设也被写下来了**（λ=2.2、20,000 次试验、1,500 条暴露）**——**这正是本轮主题的具体形态**；**⚠️ 本次未运行其流水线，上述数值为**仓库自述**，**本词条**不主张**其可复现**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **把「模型不确定性」单列而不是并进主结果**——**逐字**：**「The sensitivity analysis varies event frequency and severity assumptions. This is important because catastrophe models contain **uncertainty arising from incomplete hazard data, vulnerability assumptions and model structure**.」**，**并输出 `outputs/uncertainty_scenarios.csv` 与 `outputs/uncertainty_sensitivity.png`**；**即它把**模型不确定性**与**参数不确定性**分开对待**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其情景设计足以刻画真实模型风险**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **`RESULTS.md` 的「Interpretation」把它要教的东西拆成四项**——**逐字**：**「The project separates: 1. **frequency risk** — how often events occur; 2. **severity risk** — how damaging an event can be; 3. **exposure concentration** — where and how much value is exposed; 4. **model uncertainty** — how assumptions change estimated tail losses. **That decomposition is the main learning objective.**」**——**即**频率风险／严重度风险／暴露集中度／模型不确定性**四条分解，「而这个分解就是主要学习目标」**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **10 条「面试谈资」被直接写进 README，是本站少见的一种形态**——**逐字列出**：**为什么频率用泊松？为什么严重度用对数正态？λ 变大时会发生什么？**VaR 有什么是 TVaR 能捕捉而它不能的？**如何验证一个巨灾模型？如何把**偶然变异与模型不确定性分开**？如果两个模型给出的损失估计显著不同你会怎么办？如何把**免赔额、限额与再保分层**纳入？如何把模拟从 10,000 次扩展到数百万次？要把合成灾害模型换成真实的，你需要什么数据？**——⭐⭐ **这十条恰好是**巨灾建模面试的实际问题清单****；**对准备面试的学生，它把「项目做了什么」与「会被问什么」接在了一起**（**可与本站 [[actuarial-student-competitions]]、[[soa-practice-view-ai]] 等备考与求职条目并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这十条问题代表任何雇主的实际面试内容**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **「Suggested next upgrade（建议的下一步升级）」逐字**：**「Add an actual public hazard dataset (for example, earthquake event records), replace the synthetic hazard intensity function, and compare the simulated portfolio loss distribution under multiple assumptions.」**——**即它自己指出了**从合成走向真实**的具体一步**。**⑨ ⭐ **默认使用固定随机种子以保证可复现**（**逐字**：**「The default simulation uses a fixed random seed for reproducibility.」**）**。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站巨灾与随机建模条目并读**：[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]（**本轮同批的另两种巨灾做法**）、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[evd]]、[[eva]]、[[ismev]]、[[hazus]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（3,896 字节）全文与 `RESULTS.md`（1,360 字节）全文**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行其 `src/` 下任何脚本、未运行 `pytest`、未查看 `outputs/` 与 `data/`、未读 `sql/analysis.sql`、未读 `tests/test_simulation.py` 与 `src/` 任何源码****，因此**不能转述其合成数据的生成方式、灾害强度函数、脆弱性关系、邻近因子的具体形式、情景设计、SQL 查询或除 `RESULTS.md` 所载之外的任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 中的全部数值（EAL $261.51M、95% VaR $710.80M 等）为**仓库自述**，**本次未运行、未独立复算**；**本词条**不主张**这些数值正确或可复现**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其四条测试不变量（损失非负、期望损失低于尾部分位数、TVaR ≥ VaR、情景齐全）确实存在于 `tests/test_simulation.py` 中并通过**——**这是本条目最值得后续核实的一处**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「模型不确定性」情景的设计是否足以支撑关于模型风险的结论**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其灾害与脆弱性关系「刻意简化」到什么程度**——**其自述为「synthetic and deliberately simplified」**，**但具体简化了哪些环节本次未读**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其 README 所称「Marsh Re internship description」的存在与内容**；**本词条**不主张**其对齐有效或该招聘条件在别处可查**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **本项目为教育性模拟器****——**其自述**明确不是商业巨灾模型的替代****；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的风险定价、资本计算、再保决策或监管报送**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同日**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑩ ⭐ README 3,896 字节且无 topics**；**⑪ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 与 `RESULTS.md` 实测均为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 3,896 字节与 `RESULTS.md` 1,360 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测核对，含两条免责语句、建模框架公式、代码结构、风险指标表与十条面试问句）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读源码**。
e.body_hk:
**CatRiskSim** 是一個**組合級巨災風險與組合損失模擬項目**（倉庫 `anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 2,069 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 404）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 3,896 位元組**，**另有實測 `RESULTS.md`（1,360 位元組）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把假設寫成可核對的東西」**中的**第一種：把「我不主張什麼」寫成開篇第一段**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字**：**「Stochastic catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulator using Monte Carlo, SQL, and geospatial analysis.」**；**根目錄實測含 `.gitignore`、`README.md`、**`RESULTS.md`**、`data/`、`outputs/`、`requirements.txt`、`sql/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **「Important scope」逐字，是本條目最有價值的一段**：**「This is an **educational simulator**, **not a replacement for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR**. The hazard and vulnerability relationships are **synthetic and deliberately simplified**.」**。**建模框架逐字（公式原樣）**：**`N ~ Poisson(lambda)`**；**`S ~ Lognormal(mu, sigma)`**；**`Loss = Exposure × Vulnerability × HazardFactor × ProximityFactor`（受保額上限約束）**；**`AggregateLoss_t = sum(Loss_i)`**；**再由年度損失分布計算 EAL、95%／99% VaR 與 95%／99% TVaR**。**代碼結構逐字**：`src/generate_data.py`、`src/simulate_losses.py`、`src/run_sql.py`、`src/visualize.py`、`sql/analysis.sql`、`tests/test_simulation.py`、`outputs/`。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「明說自己不是 RMS／AIR 的替代」是最有價值的一點**——**商業巨災模型是該行業的實務工具**，**而教育性模擬器與它們之間最容易發生的誤讀就是**把教學的簡化當成可用的近似****；**作者把這條誤讀寫成開篇第二句**（**⚠️ 不主張**其簡化程度恰當或可用於任何真實定價**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「它不主張什麼」被寫成與主張並列的一段**——**逐字**：**「It intentionally covers several items in the **Marsh Re internship description** that are absent from a typical AI/ML student resume: … **It does not claim experience with proprietary RMS/AIR/RQE models or production insurance data.**」**⭐⭐ **對正在求職的學生，這是罕見地把「我的項目補哪一塊」與「我不聲稱補到了哪一塊」同時寫清的樣本**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它給測試定下四條不變量**——**`RESULTS.md` 逐字**：**「losses cannot be negative; **expected loss is below tail-risk quantiles**; **TVaR is at least as large as the corresponding VaR**; **all intended uncertainty scenarios are present**」**⭐⭐ **前三條是**分布內部一致性**（單調性／支撐集）檢查，第四條是**完整性**檢查**——**一組**不依賴具體數值就能發現結構性錯誤**的斷言**（**⚠️ 未運行其 pytest**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 把一次具體運行的假設與數值並列**——**年度試驗 **20,000** 次；暴露記錄 **1,500** 條；**Poisson(lambda=2.2)**；Lognormal 嚴重度**；**並聲明「Results are synthetic and for educational use.」**；**風險指標逐字**：**EAL $261.51M｜95% VaR $710.80M｜95% TVaR $855.18M｜99% VaR $975.95M｜99% TVaR $1,087.37M｜P(Loss > $50M) 74.62%｜P(Loss > $100M) 67.91%**。⭐⭐ **這些数値得以被核對的前提是**假設也被寫下來了****（**⚠️ 未運行其流水線，上述為倉庫自述，不主張可複現**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **把「模型不確定性」單列**——**逐字**：**「The sensitivity analysis varies event frequency and severity assumptions. This is important because catastrophe models contain **uncertainty arising from incomplete hazard data, vulnerability assumptions and model structure**.」**，**並輸出 `outputs/uncertainty_scenarios.csv` 與 `uncertainty_sensitivity.png`**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **「Interpretation」把要教的東西拆成四項**——**頻率風險／嚴重度風險／暴露集中度／模型不確定性**，**並逐字稱「That decomposition is the main learning objective.」**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **10 條「面試談資」直接寫進 README**——**含「為什麼頻率用泊松」「VaR 有什麼是 TVaR 能捕捉而它不能的」「如何把**偶然變異與模型不確定性分開**」「如何把**免賠額、限額與再保分層**納入」等**——⭐⭐ **這十條恰好是**巨災建模面試的實際問題清單****（**⚠️ 不主張**這十條代表任何雇主的實際面試內容**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **「Suggested next upgrade」逐字**：**「Add an actual public hazard dataset (for example, earthquake event records), replace the synthetic hazard intensity function, and compare the simulated portfolio loss distribution under multiple assumptions.」**——**它自己指出了**從合成走向真實**的具體一步**。**⑨ ⭐ 預設使用固定隨機種子以保證可複現**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[evd]]、[[eva]]、[[ismev]]、[[hazus]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄並提示使用、修改或再分發前自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、根目錄清單、README 全文與 `RESULTS.md` 全文**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝、未運行 `src/` 下任何腳本、未運行 `pytest`、未查看 `outputs/` 與 `data/`、未讀 `sql/analysis.sql`、未讀 `tests/test_simulation.py` 與任何原始碼****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 中全部數值為**倉庫自述****，**未運行、未獨立復算**，**不主張**其正確或可複現**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其四條測試不變量確實存在於 `tests/test_simulation.py` 中並通過**——**這是本條目最值得後續核實的一處**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「模型不確定性」情景設計是否足以支撐關於模型風險的結論**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其災害與脆弱性關係「刻意簡化」到什麼程度**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其 README 所稱「Marsh Re internship description」的存在與內容**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **本項目為教育性模擬器****，**其自述明確不是商業巨災模型的替代**，**不主張**其可用於任何真實的風險定價、資本計算、再保決策或監管報送**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建與推送同日**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑩ ⭐ README 3,896 位元組且無 topics**；**⑪ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行、未讀原始碼**。

**CatRiskSim** is **a portfolio-level catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulation project** (repository `anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 2,069 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on the main branch)** and **no topics**; **the README measures 3,896 bytes**, **and a `RESULTS.md` of 1,360 bytes is also measurably present**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **writing assumptions into something a reader can check**: **stating what it does not claim in its opening paragraph**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"Stochastic catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulator using Monte Carlo, SQL, and geospatial analysis."**; **the root measurably contains `.gitignore`, `README.md`, `RESULTS.md`, `data/`, `outputs/`, `requirements.txt`, `sql/`, `src/` and `tests/`**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its opening "Important scope" passage, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable part**: **"This is an educational simulator, not a replacement for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR. The hazard and vulnerability relationships are synthetic and deliberately simplified."** **Its modelling framework reads verbatim (formulas as written)**: **`N ~ Poisson(lambda)`**; **`S ~ Lognormal(mu, sigma)`**; **`Loss = Exposure × Vulnerability × HazardFactor × ProximityFactor` subject to a policy limit**; **`AggregateLoss_t = sum(Loss_i)` for all events in year t**; **the simulated annual-loss distribution then yields EAL, 95%/99% VaR and 95%/99% TVaR**. **Its code structure reads verbatim**: `src/generate_data.py`, `src/simulate_losses.py`, `src/run_sql.py`, `src/visualize.py`, `sql/analysis.sql`, `tests/test_simulation.py` and `outputs/`.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Stating outright that it is not a substitute for RMS or AIR is the entry’s most valuable point, and one of the most forthright opening boundary statements this session has seen** — **commercial catastrophe models are the profession’s working tools**, **and the easiest misreading between them and an educational simulator is to treat a teaching simplification as a usable approximation**; **the author writes that misreading into the second sentence** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its simplification is appropriate or usable for any real pricing — its model was not run**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ What it does not claim is written as a paragraph standing beside what it does claim** — verbatim: **"It intentionally covers several items in the Marsh Re internship description that are absent from a typical AI/ML student resume: stochastic modelling, risk/loss distributions, model uncertainty, SQL, geospatial analysis, interpretation of modelled loss outputs, quality-control checks, process automation. It does not claim experience with proprietary RMS/AIR/RQE models or production insurance data."** ⭐⭐ **For a student job-hunting, a rare sample that states both which gap the project fills and which gap it does not claim to have filled.** **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It gives its tests four invariants, the entry’s most notable engineering point** — **`RESULTS.md` reads verbatim**: **"losses cannot be negative; expected loss is below tail-risk quantiles; TVaR is at least as large as the corresponding VaR; all intended uncertainty scenarios are present."** ⭐⭐ **The first three are internal-consistency checks on a distribution (monotonicity and support) and the fourth is a completeness check** — **assertions that can expose structural errors without depending on particular values** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]]**; **⚠️ its pytest was not run, so whether these four hold was not verified**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` sets one specific run’s assumptions and values side by side, the entry’s easiest part to check** — verbatim: **annual trials 20,000; exposure records 1,500; core frequency model Poisson(lambda=2.2); severity model Lognormal**; **and it states verbatim "Results are synthetic and for educational use."**; **its risk-metric table reads verbatim**: **EAL $261.51M | 95% VaR $710.80M | 95% TVaR $855.18M | 99% VaR $975.95M | 99% TVaR $1,087.37M | P(Loss > $50M) 74.62% | P(Loss > $100M) 67.91%**. ⭐⭐ **These numbers are checkable only because the assumptions were written down too (lambda = 2.2, 20,000 trials, 1,500 exposures) — the concrete form of this round’s theme** (**⚠️ its pipeline was not run; the figures are the repository’s own account and reproducibility is not claimed**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Model uncertainty is separated rather than folded into the headline result** — verbatim: **"The sensitivity analysis varies event frequency and severity assumptions. This is important because catastrophe models contain uncertainty arising from incomplete hazard data, vulnerability assumptions and model structure."**, **with `outputs/uncertainty_scenarios.csv` and `uncertainty_sensitivity.png` produced** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its scenario design is sufficient to characterise real model risk**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md`’s "Interpretation" splits what it teaches into four items** — **frequency risk, severity risk, exposure concentration and model uncertainty** — **and states verbatim "That decomposition is the main learning objective."** **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Ten "Interview talking points" are written directly into the README**, **including why Poisson for frequency, what VaR fails to capture that TVaR does, how to separate aleatory variability from model uncertainty, and how to incorporate deductibles, limits and reinsurance layers** — ⭐⭐ **precisely the questions catastrophe-modelling interviews actually ask**, **joining what the project did to what will be asked about it** (**readable with the site’s exam and career entries such as [[actuarial-student-competitions]] and [[soa-practice-view-ai]]**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim these ten represent any employer’s actual interview**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ "Suggested next upgrade" reads verbatim**: **"Add an actual public hazard dataset (for example, earthquake event records), replace the synthetic hazard intensity function, and compare the simulated portfolio loss distribution under multiple assumptions."** — **it names the concrete step from synthetic toward real itself**. **⑨ ⭐ The default simulation uses a fixed random seed for reproducibility** (stated verbatim). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the site’s catastrophe and stochastic modelling entries**: [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] (**this round’s other two catastrophe approaches**), [[openquake-engine]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[oasislmf]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[catmodeling]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[extremeloss]], [[evd]], [[eva]], [[ismev]] and [[hazus]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use, modification or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the root listing, the full 3,896-byte README and the full 1,360-byte `RESULTS.md`**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run any script under `src/`, run pytest, inspect `outputs/` or `data/`, read `sql/analysis.sql`, or read `tests/test_simulation.py` or any source**, so **its synthetic data generation, hazard intensity function, vulnerability relationships, the concrete form of its proximity factor, its scenario design, its SQL queries and any figure beyond those in `RESULTS.md` cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Every figure in `RESULTS.md` (EAL $261.51M, 95% VaR $710.80M and the rest) is the repository’s own account, and nothing was run or independently recomputed**; **the entry does not claim those figures are correct or reproducible**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its four test invariants actually exist in `tests/test_simulation.py` and pass was not verified** — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether its model-uncertainty scenarios are adequate to support conclusions about model risk was not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ How far its hazard and vulnerability relationships are "deliberately simplified" was not verified** — **it says so itself, but which steps are simplified was not read**; **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The existence and content of the "Marsh Re internship description" it names was not verified**; **the entry does not claim the alignment is valid or that the posting is findable elsewhere**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ The project is an educational simulator and states itself that it is not a substitute for commercial catastrophe models**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real risk pricing, capital calculation, reinsurance decision or supervisory filing**; **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed the same day**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ ⭐ A 3,896-byte README with no topics**; **⑪ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**both the README and `RESULTS.md` measurably are in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 3,896-byte README and 1,360-byte `RESULTS.md` read via `raw.githubusercontent.com`, with both disclaimer sentences, the modelling formulas, code structure, risk-metric table and the ten interview questions checked verbatim); **nothing cloned, installed or run, and no source read**.
